business_summary: Pubang Landscape Architecture Co., Ltd engages in the garden engineering construction and garden landscape design businesses in China. The company offers ecological landscape services, including project planning, architecture, landscape, tourism, municipal engineering, ecology, interior design, and BIM design; engineering construction services; and produces and sells flowers and trees. It also provides urban operation services, such as greening maintenance, sanitation and cleaning, urban renewal, community micro-renovation, and seasonal flower arrangement; water environment management and water landscape construction services; forestry and garden technology consulting services; and sales of flooring products. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
